t: Tabs and navigation, smart omnibox, personalization, private by design, downloads, extensions.
Screenshots of the Astarix main window and the Settings panel.
Download the portable exe, double-click to run, browse and customize in Settings.
Windows 10 or 11 x64, about 250 MB free disk space, no administrator rights needed.
Get Astarix-Browser-Portable.exe from the GitHub Releases page, about 90 MB.
Double-click the exe to run with no installation. First run opens a new tab.
Clone the repo, npm install, npm start for development, npm run build for the portable exe.
Download the newer release and replace the exe. Your profile and settings are kept.
Delete the exe. Optionally remove the profile folder from %APPDATA%.
Open the menu and choose Settings to open the settings side panel.
Dark and light themes plus seven accent colors applied across the whole interface.
Open with a blank new tab or with your own homepage URL on launch.
Show or hide bookmark shortcuts and pick a custom background color.
Default search engine Google Bing or DuckDuckGo, plus live search suggestions toggle.
Default page zoom level and a custom downloads folder.
Reset All Settings restores every option to its default value.
Sandboxed renderer, context isolation, strict CSP, non-HTTP navigation blocked.
Camera microphone geolocation notifications USB and display capture are denied by default.
Obfuscated production builds, Electron fuses, remote debugging switches blocked.
Dangerous permissions and all-urls host access are blocked before an extension loads.
Every download asks where to save, filenames are sanitized against traversal.
History bookmarks and settings stay on your machine, nothing is uploaded.
The build is unsigned, Windows SmartScreen may warn. Choose More info then Run anyway.
Only unpacked extension folders can be loaded, store installs are not supported.
No, Astarix supports HTTP and HTTPS only, anything else becomes a search.
Press F12 or use the menu. Remote debugging from other processes is blocked.
Only Windows x64 portable builds are published for now.
Use Reset All Settings, or delete the profile folder for a completely fresh start.
Performance mode Auto On Off. Strips animations blur and shadows on weak machines, auto-detected from CPU cores and RAM.
Automatic low-end profile with smaller heap and cache, single raster thread, and performance mode.
